openwrt_wiki.Flash Layout: spi0.0 w25q128jv 16384 KiB; RouterBoot 0x0-0x40000 (bootloader1, hard_config, bootloader2, soft_config, bios); firmware 0x40000-0x1000000 16128 KiB (kernel 1920 KiB, rootfs 14208 KiB)
openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: Case is held together by plastic clips on the bottom of case. To open, using screwdriver push clips in slots outwards, this will release bottom panel.
openwrt_wiki.OpenWrt bootlog Auszug: Linux 4.14.91; SoC Type: MediaTek MT7621 ver:1 eco:3; CPU0 MIPS 1004Kc; machine is MikroTik RouterBOARD 750Gr3; Memory 253428K/262144K; CPU Clock 880MHz; m25p80 spi0.0: w25q128jv (16384 Kbytes); xhci-mtk (USB 3.0 Host, 1 Port + 2-Port-USB2-Hub); Kernel command line console=ttyS0,115200; input: beeper
openwrt_wiki.SPI-Header Hinweis: Pin 8 auf GND hält den SoC an; VCC nicht vom Programmer, Gerät über eigenes Netzteil versorgen
openwrt_wiki.Installation (knapp): MikroTik-Common-Procedure (TFTP-Netboot initramfs, dann sysupgrade); RouterBOOT aus RouterOS 6.49.x hat ~7 MiB Grenze für TFTP-Image; Geräte mit RouterOS 7.16.2 vor dem Netboot auf mindestens 7.19.6 bringen; initramfs 23.05.0-rc3 bootet per Netboot, andere 23.05-Stände wegen Einsprungadresse nicht

openwrt_wiki_alt.Serial: Notice: 2018/09/15: I tried connecting serial to the pinouts as pictured, but they are labelled incorrectly. In this case, connect TX to TX and RX to RX, instead of TX to RX as it is normally
openwrt_wiki_alt.SPI-Header: There is an unoccupied pin header on the PCB of the 750Gr3 which can be used to write the flash without having to de-solder it from the board.
openwrt_wiki_alt.Bootloader-Hinweis: The factory bootloader (RouterBOOT) and firmware (RouterOS) do not provide any console output

hersteller_broschuere.Merkmale: hEX (revision 3); 880 MHz CPU, 2 cores and 4 threads; 256 MB RAM; microSD slot; Full size USB; IPsec hardware acceleration; Same form factor; Same price

hersteller_handbuch.Mounting: This device is designed for use indoors by placing it on the flat surface or mounting on the wall ... Screws with size 4x25 mm fit nicely ... dowels 6x30 mm and 6 mm drill bit ... cable feed is pointing downwards ... The IP rating scale for this device is IPX0.
hersteller_handbuch.Powering: Direct input power jack (5.5mm outside and 2mm inside, female, pin positive) accepts 8-30 V DC. The first Ethernet port accepts passive Power over Ethernet 8-30 V DC. 12 V or more is recommended to compensate for the loss in cables.
hersteller_handbuch.Power consumption: under maximum load with attachments 10 W. Without attachments 5 W.
hersteller_handbuch.Ports: five individual Ethernet ports (Auto MDI/X); MicroSD card slot; USB type A slot; port 1 labeled 'Internet', local network ports 2-5
hersteller_handbuch.Reset button: Press and apply power: release when green LED flashes = reset config; LED solid green = clear all config and bridge all interfaces; after LED off (~20 s) = Netinstall; button pressed before power = backup RouterBOOT loader
hersteller_handbuch.Accessories: DC EU/US Switching Power Supply 24 V, 0.38 A, 9 W, Level VI, cable: 1.5 m
hersteller_handbuch.FCC: Class B digital device, Part 15 (keine FCC-ID genannt)

hersteller_quickguide.Zeile hEX lite, hEX: DC Jack / PoE In Ethernet Port; DC Adapter 24 V / 0.38A; IP20; -40°..+60°C
hersteller_quickguide.Einsatz: This product is intended to be installed indoors.
hersteller_quickguide.Typenschild: You can find the product model name on the case label (ID).
hersteller_quickguide.Hinweis: This device needs to be upgraded to RouterOS v7.12 or the latest version to ensure compliance with local authority regulations
